provider.description: Provider token the sink routed this delivery under (path segment {provider}).

deliveryId.description: Vendor delivery id when the kernel could extract one; adapters derive their own dedupe key otherwise.

contentType.description: Verbatim Content-Type of the inbound HTTP delivery.

body.description: Raw request body, base64-encoded. Verbatim bytes preserve HMAC signature verifiability provider-side.

headers.description: Verbatim inbound webhook headers (signature, event, delivery-id headers included). Signature verification is provider-local in the adapter.
